description: Reference assets for the news-video workflow: 3-character sakuga cast, voice samples, environment refs, and topic-introducing composite examples.

files.characters/sakuga_maya.png: Primary cast — sharp female anchor, anime sakuga style, 3-pose turnaround + 4 expressions. Used as `reference_images` for any clip Maya appears in.
files.characters/sakuga_trip.png: Primary cast — blonde himbo co-host, anime sakuga style, 3-pose turnaround + 4 expressions.
files.characters/sakuga_faq9000.png: Primary cast — deadpan tin robot with single red eye, anime sakuga style, 3-pose turnaround + 4 detail close-ups.
files.characters/alternates/laika_*.png: Same 3-character cast in Laika/Aardman claymation style. Use these to swap visual style without changing personality. Has been confirmed to pass Seedance moderation.
files.characters/alternates/robotchicken_*.png: Same 3-character cast in Robot Chicken plastic-action-figure style. WARNING: triggers Seedance E005 photoreal-human moderation; use as reference for static images only, not video generation.
files.voices/maya_voice.wav: 5.8s WAV of Maya's voice (sharp, polished female anchor delivery). Pass via `reference_audios` to keep Maya's voice consistent across clips.
files.voices/trip_voice.wav: 4.0s WAV of Trip's voice (warm, upbeat himbo delivery). Pass via `reference_audios`.
files.environments/sakuga_newsroom.png: Empty news studio set with desk, name plates, BREAKING NEWS neon, CRT wall. Note: rendered slightly photoreal/cinematic, less anime than the cast — use as a vibe reference, not a direct match for the cast style.
files.environments/sakuga_scene_china.png: B-roll scene ref — airliner at sunset over Pacific. Example of single-subject motion-suggestive scene.
files.environments/sakuga_scene_dhs.png: B-roll scene ref — Capitol dome at night with autumn leaves. Example.
files.environments/sakuga_scene_fbi.png: B-roll scene ref — federal HQ building under overcast sky. Example.
files.composites/comp_patel.png: Topic-introducing composite — cast at desk + portrait on TV monitor + bold caption ('KASH PATEL'). Example of the pattern; generate your own per topic.
files.composites/comp_china.png: Topic-introducing composite — Trump portrait + 'TRUMP — CHINA TRIP' caption. WARNING: this composite triggers Seedance copyright filter when used as a reference for video generation. Kept here as a cautionary example — see strategy doc.
files.composites/comp_dhs.png: Topic-introducing composite — Capitol on TV + 'DHS SHUTDOWN — DAY 50' caption. Passes Seedance moderation cleanly. Best example of the pattern.

notes: Pack files are NOT committed to the repo — pull from GCS via scripts/asset_pack_pull.py.
The local pull location (runs/asset-packs/) is gitignored.
Path references in docs/news-video/examples/*.json assume the pack is pulled to runs/asset-packs/news-show-v1/.
